walls.note: Front (the way he walks): Commons photos show the striding bronze, shawl, book and staff, the block with its plate and the paving; panoramas see the figure small from the side.

items.where: Gandhi striding, bald with round glasses, shawl over the left shoulder, dhoti, bare thin legs, bent a little forward
items.how: builder: figure kit striding pose, clothing-kit dhoti legs and shawl lumps, bald glasses head; the shawl drape folds and the toes are simplified

items.where: long staff in the right hand (viewer left), book under the left arm
items.how: builder: rod from the slab to above the hand; dark box book at the left hand

items.where: limestone block 1.1 m square with a dark plate MAHATMA GANDHI / 1869 - 1948 on the front
items.how: builder: stone box, dark plate, two raised stroke lines

items.where: two circles of cobbles with stone kerbs, three wooden benches on stone legs and a hedge behind
items.how: builder: stone/cobble rings, three benches, 17 hedge boxes

walls.note: Rear: inferred from the front and side photos; simplified.
